text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. conquered the Japanese Derby. 
Katsuragi Ace threw everything she had 
into the race, but her current self still 
wasn't enough to reach her.

Even so, the trust from her Trainer and 
friends remains unshaken. In order to live 
up to their expectations, Katsuragi Ace 
forcefully declared that she would win 
next time.

With each passing day, acclaim for Mr. 
C.B. only grew. In truth, her talent was 
in a league of its own. Faced with such a 
gap, some Umamusume chose to step away 
from the front lines.

Katsuragi Ace's road ahead is harsh. Her 
Trainer vows to continue supporting her. 
Her next race—the third leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho.
